reason: We can only go on Saturdays, so $59 a month for maybe 4 visits doesn't pencil out on our budget, and I'd rather pay drop-in if I ever try it. With a baby, I don't want to pay to find out if it's crowded with 4 and 5 year olds.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Nothing here says there's a separate space for babies, and I'd be paying for weekends only.
would_change_my_mind: A clearly separate, gated baby area, plus a way to try a Saturday drop-in with no membership commitment and limits on how many kids are in at once.
